description: Asks what ACE does with SQL text that is not ordinary text, passed as the BSTR argument of Database.OpenRecordset (snapshot) and then of Database.Execute (dbFailOnError, on a writable copy): an odd-byte BSTR (the text of SELECT 1 AS v FROM One plus one extra byte 0x00, 0x20 and 0x41), a lone high or low surrogate inside a string literal and inside a bracketed alias, an astral pair in a literal and in an alias, a leading U+FEFF, U+0000 at the end, before FROM and between two statements, U+FFFE and U+0001 inside a literal, a 255, 256, 257 and 4,000-character literal, and a 64- and 65-character alias; and INSERT INTO U (ID, K) VALUES with a lone surrogate and with an odd-byte BSTR statement, followed by the rows of U with Len(K) and LenB(K). Each call is followed by DBEngine.Errors. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
